message: GKE TCPXO network auto-detection found 7 networks allocatable on every target node (c1-gpu-nic-0, c1-gpu-nic-1, c1-gpu-nic-2, c1-gpu-nic-3, c1-gpu-nic-4, c1-gpu-nic-5, c1-gpu-nic-6), but TCPXO needs exactly 8 GPU NIC networks per node (a3-megagpu-8g); rendering the default networks gpu-nic0..gpu-nic7 instead; GKE rejects the pods unless Network objects with those names exist.
